ValidationRule.description: Keeps Start Date and End Date in the correct order on Foundation Grant and Government Grant opportunities. Fires only when both are populated, so a record can still be saved mid-entry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Foundation_Grant', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Government_Grant' ), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), End_Date__c < Start_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Date must be on or after Start Date.
